authorization: The user asked the asset-authoring session to define a neutral convention. These frame placements are design choices, not observations of Weft.
frame_space: Proposed world-space transforms at an authored standing visual neutral; column-major matrices when serialized.
side_convention: At the proposed front view, +X is viewer-right and anatomical left; -X is viewer-left and anatomical right.

mapping_equation.B_world: Actual exported glTF global default/bind transform of the bound node, not its local transform or its name.

assumptions: All ten proposed target frame rotations are identity; this does not assert that any Weft joint angle vector is zero or canonical.
Coordinates suggest a standing figure with arms angled outward/downward; they do not recover anatomy or change the source authored bind pose.
Uniform scale 1 is an explicit visual choice, not metric calibration of simulation units.
Offsets preserve the source authored bind pose under this proposal; actual Weft frame origins and rotations remain unverified.
Use actual glTF node indices. AvatarRig must contain the rendered mesh and all skin joints and is bound to mobile_root.
Only ten supplied body frames drive visuals. Unmapped descendants retain their local rest transforms; no independent head, hand, finger or dragon physics is invented.
No Weft physics, actions, rewards, recording code or importer is modified by this proposal.
consumer_correction: Once actual neutral world transforms F_actual(q0) are available, recompute each C_actual = inverse(F_actual(q0)) * G * B_world * inverse(G), retaining model/rig/geometry/inverse-bind data. Verify neutral skinning and live joint/root perturbations before claiming alignment.

algebra_check.method: In-memory matrix identity check across all ten proposed F0 frames using an independently constructed translated/rotated source transform; not a Weft runtime test.
